title: Torsors under a classical group over an affine base
statement:
Let $X$ be an affine scheme, $G_0$ a sheaf of groups on $X_{\Et}$ and
$G=\nu_X^*G_0$. Let $T$ be a $G$-torsor on $X_{\Proet}$, i.e. a sheaf of sets with
a left $G$-action such that $G\times T\to T\times T$, $(g,t)\mapsto(gt,t)$, is an
isomorphism and $T\to *$ is an epimorphism. Then there are an affine étale
surjection $U_i\to X$, a $G_0$-torsor $T_0$ on $X_{\Et}$ with $T_0(U_i)\neq\emptyset$,
and an isomorphism of $G$-torsors $\nu_X^*T_0\cong T$. In particular $T$ is
classical and is trivialized by the étale covering $\{U_i\to X\}$.

proof.text: The image sieve of the epic terminal map covers. Take the family of every pro-etale object equipped with a section. The inverse of the torsor pair map gives an explicit local isomorphism from the restricted group to the restricted torsor. Restriction is the scheme inverse image by the map/pullback adjunction. The canonical comparison/pullback isomorphism identifies the restricted group as the inverse image of its etale inverse image. Thus T is locally classical.

Apply the first clause of lem-weil-pbc-proetale-locally-classical-etale-cover to obtain an etale sheaf P and an isomorphism e from its comparison inverse image to T. This general theorem contains the affine-continuity and descent argument of Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 5.1.4, so no separate torsor cocycle construction is needed here.

Conjugate the given action by e. The comparison unit is invertible, hence the comparison inverse image is fully faithful. Its finite-product-preserving monoidal structure allows taking the preimage of the cotensorator followed by the conjugated action. Apply faithfulness after tensorator naturality and coherence to prove both action laws. The image of the etale pair map is the conjugated pro-etale pair map up to invertible product comparisons, so full faithfulness reflects its invertibility. The image of the terminal map is epic, hence faithfulness reflects its epimorphism. All conjugation, action-law, isomorphism and epimorphism calculations are proved explicitly in private Lean helpers.

Apply the finite affine covering-sieve refinement to the image sieve of P to the terminal etale sheaf on the identity object. Put the resulting finite affine etale family into the affine pro-etale site, using the existing sigmaCover spectrum-of-product construction. Its component inclusions are open immersions and cover its affine source, so etale source locality makes its structure map etale. Joint surjectivity of the original finite family gives surjectivity. Transport its local sections through the comparison unit and apply AffineProEt.exists_sigmaCover_glue to the restricted comparison inverse image. The comparison unit is invertible on the resulting etale object, so its inverse returns the glued section to P. The lifted finite index allows arbitrary universe u and includes the empty family.

Use the essential-image criterion with witness P to prove IsClassical T. The action preimage identity followed by e proves the required equivariance equation. Map the section of P through the comparison unit and then e to obtain a section of T on exactly the same affine etale surjection.

lean.statement: theorem torsor_comparison_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (G₀ : Grp (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))) (T : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (a : (torsorComparisonPullback X).obj G₀.X ⊗ T ⟶ T) (h_one : (MonObj.one (X := (torsorComparisonPullback X).obj G₀.X) ▷ T) ≫ a = (λ_ T).hom) (h_mul : (MonObj.mul (X := (torsorComparisonPullback X).obj G₀.X) ▷ T) ≫ a = (α_ _ _ T).hom ≫ ((torsorComparisonPullback X).obj G₀.X ◁ a) ≫ a) (h_iso : IsIso (lift a (snd ((torsorComparisonPullback X).obj G₀.X) T))) (h_epi : Epi (toUnit T)) : ∃ (V : X.Etale), IsAffine V.left ∧ Surjective V.hom ∧ ∃ (T₀ : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (a₀ : G₀.X ⊗ T₀ ⟶ T₀), (MonObj.one (X := G₀.X) ▷ T₀) ≫ a₀ = (λ_ T₀).hom ∧ (MonObj.mul (X := G₀.X) ▷ T₀) ≫ a₀ = (α_ G₀.X G₀.X T₀).hom ≫ (G₀.X ◁ a₀) ≫ a₀ ∧ IsIso (lift a₀ (snd G₀.X T₀)) ∧ Epi (toUnit T₀) ∧ Nonempty (T₀.obj.obj (op V)) ∧ ∃ e : (torsorComparisonPullback X).obj T₀ ≅ T, Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (torsorComparisonPullback X) G₀.X T₀ ≫ (torsorComparisonPullback X).map a₀ ≫ e.hom = ((torsorComparisonPullback X).obj G₀.X ◁ e.hom) ≫ a ∧ IsClassical T ∧ Nonempty (T.obj.obj (op ((Scheme.toProEt X).obj V)))
